methodology: Authored and labeled before running retrieval. Labels refer only to corpus source; this file is outside the indexed corpus. One author, no independent human adjudication. Every third query is tuning; the remaining 32 are held out. Do not tune on held-out results.
quality_limitations: Small authored navigation fixture, one labeler, 48 queries and one run on one laptop; not evidence of large-repository generalization.

embedding.query_instruction: Given a code search query, retrieve relevant source code that implements the requested behavior.

latency_method: Model unloaded before cold query. Per query lexical, semantic, hybrid; hybrid reuses the query vector populated by semantic. warm_uncached_semantic excludes the one cold query and measures actual inference with a loaded model.
